logic.allocation: Raw positive fixed interests wB/wE in two independently fully funded native10000USDT strategy NAV units. Funded capital=10000*(wB+wE); no normalization, borrowing, cash transfers, NAV resizing, rebalancing or parent fills. Fractional NAV interest is an accounting participation in the complete original native bank, NOT a fractional perpetual order. Each native bank retains its exact original quantity/tick/LOT/cost/funding/margin path.
logic.valuation: At common event key, parent NAV=wB*lastcompleted BTC source NAV + wE*lastcompleted ETH source NAV. Absolute net NAV added once; recompute every return, daily Sharpe, Calmar, whole continuous OOS and fold/recent drawdown from that combined curve, never average component returns or Sharpe.
logic.alignment: Union integer relative-nanosecond/event-code keys, preserve pre/post funding and order priority. Carry only last completed source point on an absent asset key; no interpolation or future lookup.
logic.costs: Use the separately actually backtested1/2/3x source net NAV. Allocate source commission, halfspread, slippage, lagged-volume square-root impact, tick rounding, funding outflow stress and realized PnL in fixed funded-interest units exactly once. No new parent turnover costs because parent has no orders. Assume zero additional subscription/redemption/management fees for these hypothetical NAV interests.
logic.funding_and_borrow: Actual settlement ns/mark/quantity cashflows are inherited from linear-perpetual source ledgers; outflows stressed, inflows not amplified. Source shorts use native cash collateral, not unverified spot borrow; parent interests fully funded, no leveraged purchase or cross-margin.
logic.risk: Every original native bank must pass its own source order/cash/1% closed-hour adverse-mark maintenance proxy; never offset an underlying violation with the other bank. Parent complete-curve DD includes aligned minute/mark/funding/order states. No true tick-liquidation or historical full-tier/L2/TCA guarantee.
logic.continuity: Cold native sources at2025-10-19UTC00:01 and costed terminal2026-10-24UTC00:01, continuous370days with no account reset. Twelve complete30day folds plus10day tail; recent40 inherits day330 bank values and state. Fixed interests throughout, no OOS training or weight selection.
logic.execution_scope: This is a passive funded net-NAV-interest allocation backtest using real historical component results. It does NOT claim that directly scaling/aggregating native exchange orders preserves LOT/tick or nonlinear impact, and does not establish capacity at a larger total executed notional. Such implementation requires a separate newly reserved native execution test.
